policy: Coverage describes the reviewed scope of each exact reference. Execution is derived only from current named test results or specific report cases. Partial evidence is never a satisfied catalog case. No cloud or release certification is inferred. The legacy unimplemented label means no accepted current execution reference for the planned case; it is not proof that the runtime feature is absent. Dated cloud evidence remains separate from the current local-CI mapping.
